name: mcp-manager-2.0.3
body:
Cut from `main` (310cf28). Changes since `mcp-manager-2.0.2`, scoped to what actually ships in this image.

### apps/mcp-manager

- **`getConnections` is now ordered by `createdAt ASC`.** The free-plan cap keeps the first N connections, and without a deterministic `ORDER BY` Postgres could return rows in any order across requests — a plugin could show as locked on one refresh and unlocked on the next (#1459). Regression guard added in `test/mcp/get-connections-order.spec.ts`.
- **The available-integrations catalog is cached per `(org, page, pageSize, appName)` for 5 minutes.** It came from a slow per-provider external round-trip on every request. Connection state is still read live and merged after a cache hit, so `isConnected` / `connectionStatus` never go stale. A catalog assembled while any provider failed is never cached, so a momentary provider outage can't be frozen in for 5 minutes.

### libs/mcp-server/mcp-adapter

- **`callTool` now throws when the tool result carries `isError`.** MCP tools report execution failures via `isError` + content text rather than by throwing, so callers were treating messages like `MCP error -32602 ...` as real data.

Nothing else in the monorepo reaches this image: `apps/mcp-manager` imports exactly one path outside itself, `@libs/mcp-server/mcp-adapter`.
